name: pneumatics-iso6358
source:
// ISO 6358 pneumatic restriction: choked, subsonic and no-flow branches
{ A sonic conductance C and critical pressure ratio b characterise the valve.
  Supply is 6 bar gauge (700 kPa absolute) at 20 C. }
C = 0.0000000085
b = 0.35
Pup = 700000 [Pa]
Tup = 293.15 [K]

mdot_choked = iso6358(C, b, Pup, Tup, 100000 [Pa])
mdot_atchoke = iso6358(C, b, Pup, Tup, 245000 [Pa])
mdot_sub = iso6358(C, b, Pup, Tup, 500000 [Pa])
mdot_nearclosed = iso6358(C, b, Pup, Tup, 699000 [Pa])
mdot_equal = iso6358(C, b, Pup, Tup, Pup)
mdot_reverse = iso6358(C, b, Pup, Tup, 900000 [Pa])

mdot_hot = iso6358(C, b, Pup, 400 [K], 100000 [Pa])
mdot_b0 = iso6358(C, 0, Pup, Tup, 500000 [Pa])
mdot_zeroC = iso6358(0, b, Pup, Tup, 100000 [Pa])
mdot_badP = iso6358(C, b, -100, Tup, 50000 [Pa])
mdot_badT = iso6358(C, b, Pup, -5, 50000 [Pa])
